close_reason: Added a '# Version coupling with jmap-types' section to the crate-level docstring documenting that this crate's public API is coupled to jmap-types' public API via the re-exports, and that consumers depending on both must keep the jmap-types version pinned to the exact version jmap-server resolves to (or prefer not depending on jmap-types directly and using jmap_server::{Id, JmapError, ...} instead). Pure doc change.
title: pub use jmap_types::* re-exports lock jmap-server's major version to jmap-types's major version without documenting the coupling
